summary: Dependency-confusion beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: Package under the @grabcad scope presents as a 'compatibility shim' but ships no real functionality — index.js exports a Proxy that returns no-ops for any property access. Its only runtime behavior is a beacon: beacon.cjs collects os.hostname(), __dirname (install path), process.cwd(), and process.version and POSTs them as JSON to the hardcoded plain-HTTP bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. The beacon fires both from the declared postinstall script (node beacon.cjs) and at require-time from index.js, so installing or importing the package transmits installer host identifiers to the attacker-controlled destination. The scope + stub body + install/import-time host reconnaissance pattern is consistent with a dependency-confusion probe targeting an internal @grabcad package name.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
